channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2019-7238 — Sonatype Nexus Repository Manager
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Sonatype Nexus Repository Manager before 3.15.0 has an incorrect access control vulnerability. Exploitation allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2019-10758 — MongoDB mongo-express
item.description: Threat Signal 77. mongo-express before 0.54.0 is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution via endpoints that uses the `toBSON` method.

item.title: CVE-2021-27104 — Accellion FTA
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Accellion FTA contains an OS command injection vulnerability exploited via a crafted POST request to various admin endpoints.

item.title: CVE-2020-17463 — Fuel CMS Fuel CMS
item.description: Threat Signal 78. FUEL CMS 1.4.7 allows SQL Injection via the col parameter to /pages/items, /permissions/items, or /navigation/items.

item.title: CVE-2021-27103 — Accellion FTA
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Accellion FTA contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability exploited via a crafted POST request to wmProgressstat.html.

item.title: CVE-2021-44077 — Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus (SDP) / SupportCenter Plus
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus before 11306, ServiceDesk Plus MSP before 10530, and SupportCenter Plus before 11014 are vulnerable to unauthenticated remote code execution

item.title: CVE-2017-1000486 — Primetek Primefaces Application
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Primetek Primefaces is vulnerable to a weak encryption flaw resulting in remote code execution

item.title: CVE-2019-7609 — Elastic Kibana
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Kibana contain an arbitrary code execution flaw in the Timelion visualizer.

item.title: CVE-2021-27101 — Accellion FTA
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Accellion FTA contains a SQL injection vulnerability exploited via a crafted host header in a request to document_root.html.

item.title: CVE-2019-9670 — Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS)
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains an improper restriction of XML external entity (XXE) vulnerability in the mailboxd component.

item.title: CVE-2019-10149 — Exim Mail Transfer Agent (MTA)
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Improper validation of recipient address in deliver_message() function in /src/deliver.c may lead to remote command execution.

item.title: CVE-2015-7450 — IBM WebSphere Application Server and Server Hypervisor Edition
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Serialized-object interfaces in certain IBM analytics, business solutions, cognitive, IT infrastructure, and mobile and social products allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands

item.title: CVE-2021-44515 — Zoho Desktop Central
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Zoho Desktop Central contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code in the Desktop Central MSP server.

item.title: CVE-2021-35394 — Realtek Jungle Software Development Kit (SDK)
item.description: Threat Signal 80. RealTek Jungle SDK contains multiple memory corruption vulnerabilities which can allow an attacker to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-37415 — Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus (SDP)
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus before 11302 is vulnerable to authentication bypass that allows a few REST-API URLs without authentication

item.title: CVE-2021-21017 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Acrobat Acrobat and Reader contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to achieve code execution in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2010-1871 — Red Hat JBoss Seam 2
item.description: Threat Signal 75. JBoss Seam 2 (jboss-seam2), as used in JBoss Enterprise Application Platform 4.3.0 for Red Hat Linux, allows attackers to perform remote code execution. This vulnerability can only be exploited when the Java Security Manager is not properly configured.

item.title: CVE-2018-14847 — MikroTik RouterOS
item.description: Threat Signal 77. MikroTik RouterOS through 6.42 allows unauthenticated remote attackers to read arbitrary files and remote authenticated attackers to write arbitrary files due to a directory traversal vulnerability in the WinBox interface.

item.title: CVE-2021-40449 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Unspecified vulnerability allows for an authenticated user to escalate privileges.

item.title: CVE-2020-8816 — Pi-hole AdminLTE
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Pi-hole Web v4.3.2 (aka AdminLTE) allows Remote Code Execution by privileged dashboard users via a crafted DHCP static lease.

item.title: CVE-2017-17562 — Embedthis GoAhead
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Embedthis GoAhead before 3.6.5 allows remote code execution if CGI is enabled and a CGI program is dynamically linked.

item.title: CVE-2019-1579 — Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Remote Code Execution in PAN-OS with GlobalProtect Portal or GlobalProtect Gateway Interface enabled.

item.title: CVE-2018-13382 — Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy
item.description: Threat Signal 81. An Improper Authorization vulnerability in Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy under SSL VPN web portal allows an unauthenticated attacker to modify the password.

item.title: CVE-2017-12149 — Red Hat JBoss Application Server
item.description: Threat Signal 88. The JBoss Application Server, shipped with Red Hat Enterprise Application Platform 5.2, allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code via crafted serialized data.

item.title: CVE-2021-22204 — Perl Exiftool
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Improper neutralization of user data in the DjVu file format in Exiftool versions 7.44 and up allows arbitrary code execution when parsing the malicious image

item.title: CVE-2019-0193 — Apache Solr
item.description: Threat Signal 71. The optional Apache Solr module DataImportHandler contains a code injection vulnerability.

item.title: CVE-2021-27102 — Accellion FTA
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Accellion FTA contains an OS command injection vulnerability exploited via a local web service call.

item.title: CVE-2021-42321 — Microsoft Exchange
item.description: Threat Signal 86. An authenticated attacker could leverage improper validation in cmdlet arguments within Microsoft Exchange and perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-27860 — FatPipe WARP, IPVPN, and MPVPN software
item.description: Threat Signal 66. A vulnerability in the web management interface of FatPipe WARP, IPVPN, and MPVPN software allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to upload a file to any location on the filesystem.

item.title: CVE-2018-13383 — Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy
item.description: Threat Signal 70. A heap buffer overflow in Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy may cause the SSL VPN web service termination for logged in users.

item.title: CVE-2019-13272 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Kernel/ptrace.c in Linux kernel mishandles contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that allows local users to obtain root access.

item.title: CVE-2021-42292 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 65. A security feature bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Excel would allow a local user to perform arbitrary code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-43890 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Microsoft Windows AppX Installer contains a spoofing vulnerability which has a high impacts to confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

item.title: CVE-2019-2725 — Oracle WebLogic Server
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Injection vulnerability in the Oracle WebLogic Server component of Oracle Fusion Middleware (subcomponent: Web Services).

item.title: CVE-2021-44228 — Apache Log4j2
item.description: Threat Signal 90. Apache Log4j2 contains a vulnerability where JNDI features do not protect against attacker-controlled JNDI-related endpoints, allowing for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-40438 — Apache Apache
item.description: Threat Signal 88. A crafted request uri-path can cause mod_proxy to forward the request to an origin server choosen by the remote user. This issue affects Apache HTTP Server 2.4.48 and earlier.

item.title: CVE-2021-4102 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2013-3900 — Microsoft WinVerifyTrust function
item.description: Threat Signal 60. A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the way that the WinVerifyTrust function handles Windows Authenticode signature verification for PE files.

item.title: CVE-2021-44168 — Fortinet FortiOS
item.description: Threat Signal 56. Fortinet FortiOS "execute restore src-vis" downloads code without integrity checking, allowing an attacker to arbitrarily download files.

item.title: CVE-2020-11261 — Qualcomm Snapdragon Auto, Snapdragon Compute, Snapdragon Connectivity, Snapdragon Consumer IOT, Snapdragon Industrial IOT, Snapdragon Mobile, Snapdragon Voice & Music, Snapdragon Wearables
item.description: Threat Signal 56. Memory corruption due to improper check to return error when user application requests memory allocation of a huge size in Snapdragon Auto, Snapdragon Compute, Snapdragon Connectivity, Snapdragon Consumer IOT, Snapdragon Industrial IOT, Snapdragon Mobile, Snapdragon Voice & Music, Snapdragon Wearables

item.title: CVE-2026-19490 — Citrix NetScaler
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an authentication-bypass vulnerability involving an alternate path or channel. When the NetScaler appliance is configured as an AAA virtual server or as a Gateway (SSL VPN, ICA Proxy, CVPN, or RDP Proxy), an unauthenticated remote threat actor may be able to bypass authentication.

item.title: CVE-2025-25249 — Fortinet Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Fortinet FortiOS, FortiSwitchManager, and FortiSASE contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specially crafted packets.

item.title: CVE-2026-20079 — Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) and Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management
item.description: Threat Signal 85. Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software and Cisco Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management contain an authentication Bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and execute script files on an affected device to obtain root access to the underlying operating system.
